items.t: Felicis leads $7.5M bet on Unsiloed AI to make enterprise documents usable by AI agents
items.s: With a team of just seven, Unsiloed AI plans to compete with tech giants and specialized startups in the crowded AI document-processing market.

items.t: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed U.S. robotics companies the data they need
items.s: Founded in February, Humyn Labs competes with startups including Mecka AI and XDOF, with about 90% of its revenue coming from the U.S.
